rule: Reviewer A/B/C's historical decisions are preserved exactly. V3.1 does not retroactively make any historical reviewer wrong; it records that the OLD contract did not decide the question they were split on.

twoSeparateFields.historicalDecision: what the reviewer actually decided under V3, preserved verbatim in 09/10/11
twoSeparateFields.newContractExpectedDecision: what V3.1 would expect — recorded ONLY once genuinely independent reviewers have re-adjudicated under V3.1. It is NOT back-filled by this agent onto the historical records.
twoSeparateFields.neverMerged: these two are never written into the same field, and the historical files are never edited.

whatTheHistoricalSplitProves: Adjudicator A applied a dominant-material-content reading; B and C applied an any-claim-specific-flag reading; all three cited the same facts. That is evidence the V3 contract was underspecified. Neither position is adopted by V3.1 — see 02 and 03.
correctionCarriedForward: docs/phase-3-final-closure/11-root-cause-classification.json used a-7.1 as its worked example of the evaluator applying the any-flag rule. Measurement this mission shows a-7.1 has an EMPTY surfacedAsUnsafeBy, so the evaluator's disposition there was NOT_SPECIFICALLY_SURFACED.
